definition.MIXED: The balance combines quantities with different valuation status. It is never presented as verified as a whole.
definition.NOT_VALUED: Evidence shows the stock was not valued (for example used stock, which has no valuation method yet). It is not a zero value.
definition.UNVERIFIED: The recorded cost has no verified source (legacy zero cost, free goods without a basis, opening balance). The amount is shown as recorded, not as a confirmed value.
definition.VERIFIED: A positive cost with a traceable source (e.g. the purchase order price of a posted Goods Receipt, or a documented review).
definition.VERIFIED_ZERO: A zero inventory value with a documented basis (e.g. documented free-of-charge receipt). A purchase price of 0 alone does not make it verified.

empty: No stock balances match this filter.

help.acknowledgeMixed: I understand this balance combines sources of different status and confirm the review applies to the whole balance.
help.costNeverChanged: The recorded unit cost is shown as it is. A review changes the status only, never the cost.
help.noSources: No inbound movement with a recorded valuation source.
help.page: Shows, per warehouse balance, whether the recorded cost has a verified source. A cost of 0 is never read as 'free' or 'verified': only a documented review can say so.
help.reviewNeverEditsCost: Saving a review records who, when, why and the evidence. It does not change the cost or any stock quantity.
